parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The date is in ISO 8601 format and uses UTC. The end time must be later than the start time, and the time span cannot exceed 10 hours. If you do not specify StartTime and EndTime, data from the last hour is queried by default.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The date is in ISO 8601 format and uses UTC.
